classification_rationale: Trigger (block.timestamp/block.number read, especially in a value/timing-sensitive decision) is straightforward to detect via Slither's IR (solidity_variables_read for block.timestamp/block.number). Semantic condition ('does this introduce MEV or similar vulnerability') needs judgment -- e.g. a timestamp used only for a multi-day unlock check is far lower-risk than one used for a same-block price/auction decision.
